cases.task: create a polished, current, dependency-free one-page website concept for a new neighborhood coffee shop. Make it expressive, energetic, and visually memorable. Let the approved premise, visitor need, and available evidence determine the composition, typography, media, density, and motion; do not treat any layout, motif, type category, palette, media count, shot list, energy arc, or interaction as mandatory. Its character must emerge from a coherent rendered whole rather than a cosmetic copy, photo, or color swap. No logo, photos, address, hours, menu, history, reviews, or ordering integration were supplied. Owner-authorized generated concept photography is permitted when an image-generation capability exists: generate only media the chosen direction needs, document the purpose of every used asset, inspect it, record provenance locally, and keep it from impersonating documentary proof. If that capability is unavailable, make the strongest concept possible in the actual environment; create a photography-ready placeholder and capture brief only when the chosen composition genuinely depends on future media. A new visitor must understand that this is a coffee shop, what experience it offers, and what the primary action does from the first screen. Keep any concept disclosure to one proportionate note, use comfortable typography, make the public copy sound like a coffee shop rather than a design evaluation, do not imply an earlier decade, and keep all actions honest. Work only in this local workspace and create index.html, style.css, and any necessary local JavaScript; do not publish or contact external services.
review_requirements: Verify every task-specific constraint against source and rendered evidence; file-presence alone is insufficient.
Run an unbriefed five-second comprehension check for business type, visitor benefit, primary action, and any prominent label or control.

Review the media strategy in context. Every used asset must serve a documented project-specific visitor or content purpose and must not pretend to document a real business. Do not require a media count or predetermined editorial role; a photo-free direction is valid when the rendered concept is complete without photography.

Judge the complete render against the brief for relevance, specificity, hierarchy, visual interest, and coherent differentiation from an interchangeable copy, media, or color swap. Do not require or ban any named layout, motif, palette, type category, energy pattern, or interaction. Fail the result when its aggregate decisions are defaulted, irrelevant, internally inconsistent, or visibly unchecked.
Inspect body and display typography at narrow, intermediate, and wide widths. Reject combined tight tracking, short leading, and narrow stretch or width that makes words feel crowded.

Verify essential content is visible with JavaScript and animation disabled and in a full-page capture that does not pre-scroll every reveal target; entrance effects must fail open rather than leaving blank sections.
At 320, 375, and 430 CSS-pixel widths, inspect the actual longest heading, label, price, and control for clipping or crowding in addition to checking document overflow.
Reject public copy organized around routes, systems, methods, design proof, missing inputs, or repeated concept caveats.

cases.task: build a current dependency-free three-route concept for Relay Room, a fictional community radio studio with a small public listening room for live sessions, local hosts, audience tapings, and listening parties. Preserve that original premise. Make the experience culturally alive, expressive, and visually memorable by deriving consequential decisions from real visitor situations and the supplied premise. No visual device, channel count, energy pattern, media count, shot list, font category, or palette is required. The accountable owner rejected the earlier execution because it had no photography, compressed and crowded typography, abstract copy, a meaningless Transmission status panel, a disabled fake stream, route codes, diagrams, and interactions that did not serve a visitor. Treat that rejection as binding first-party evidence. Owner-authorized generated concept photography is permitted when the chosen direction needs it; document the purpose and provenance of every used asset and inspect artifacts rather than filling a predetermined shot list. The home route must immediately explain what Relay Room is and why someone would visit; the schedule route helps someone choose a sample session; the room route helps someone decide whether the space fits a small private event. Keep fictional event details clearly illustrative through one proportionate note, not repeated caveats. Legitimate plain-language radio and recording terms are allowed, but fake transmission state, relay codes, system metaphors, technical diagrams, proposed-room narration, and status controls are not. Use meaningful familiar labels and working local routes, comfortable typography, render desktop and narrow views, run an adversarial review, revise the result, and leave owner acceptance pending rather than self-approving it. Do not publish or contact external services.
review_requirements: Verify the rejected technical-radio pattern is absent in rendered routes and aggregate public copy, not merely renamed.
Run an unbriefed five-second comprehension check for the community-radio and public-listening-room premise, audience situation, primary action, and prominent labels or controls.

Review generated or supplied media in context for provenance, artifacts, responsive crops, truthful concept status, and the documented project-specific purpose of every used asset; do not grade the result by a predetermined shot list.

Judge the complete rendered route family for visitor relevance, Relay Room specificity, coherent art direction, useful differentiation among route jobs, and a real response to the owner's rejection. Do not require or ban a named layout, motif, palette, type category, energy pattern, media treatment, or interaction. Fail aggregate defaulting, cosmetic rewording of a familiar template, irrelevant decoration, internal inconsistency, or unchecked defects.
Inspect actual display and body typography at narrow, intermediate, and wide widths; stacked tight tracking, short leading, and narrow stretch or width requires revision.

Verify essential content is visible with JavaScript and animation disabled and in a full-page capture that does not pre-scroll every reveal target; inspect the longest content at 320, 375, and 430 CSS-pixel widths rather than relying only on document overflow.
Confirm the schedule and private-event routes support recognizable customer decisions and contain no honest-but-pointless control.
Record the result as an agent-reviewed candidate with accountable-owner acceptance pending.

cases.task: Create an expressive, maximal showcase microsite for a fictional contemporary sound-art festival whose performances are organized around field recordings from transit systems. review_requirements: Verify every task-specific constraint against source and rendered evidence; file-presence alone is insufficient.
Confirm the implementation is dependency-free and local-only and that no publication, external contact, or unsupported network behavior occurred.

Inspect completed project evidence showing which first plausible default was challenged, which consequential alternatives or counterevidence were considered, which criteria governed selection, and why the implemented direction won. Do not accept untouched prompts or file presence as exploration evidence.

Require exploration in proportion to uncertainty and consequence. A bounded decision may justify one direction; an open decision may compare more. Evidence may take any useful form, and there is no universal concept count, candidate filename, proof-page count, viewport, or artifact shape.

Judge whether the evidence exposes consequential differences in structure, attention, content organization, behavior, or another brief-relevant decision. Cosmetic substitutions and reorderings do not establish range when the underlying encounter remains the same.

Confirm the selection rationale, reasons alternatives or counterevidence lost, and reversible checkpoint are specific, and verify that the final implementation visibly carries the selected logic. Do not require a prescribed first-screen composition or menu of acceptable compositions.

When the chosen direction introduces a consequential risk to comprehension, action, accessibility, or resilience, verify the relevant fallback and states. Do not require every concept to invent an aesthetic risk, removal test, or effect.
Inspect the routes, flows, viewports, and states that best expose the selected direction and its responsive behavior. Do not require a designated representative route or fixed proof surface.

Trace all public content and media claims to the approved fictional premise and confirm unavailable dates, artists, venue, tickets, sponsors, photography, and recordings remain honest without repeated caveats.

cases.task: build a dependency-free local operating interface for Backstage Atlas, a fictional performing-arts venue prototype. Its only approved workflow is that a stage manager reviews three visibly labeled sample changeover tasks, filters them by readiness, opens one task, marks it locally complete, can undo that completion, and can reset the sample. Use Operate mode and an expressive system derived from cue sheets, stage zones, timing, and handoff sequence, while keeping blocked work, current context, status, and the next safe action ahead of visual spectacle. Add clearly labeled prototype-state controls that put the same working interface into actual loading, empty, recoverable-error, recovered-ready, and completion-success states; do not present five static specimen cards. Treat the local JavaScript state model as authoritative and maintain system parity across summary counts, filters, rows, selected detail, action availability, status text, and confirmation after every transition. Make states understandable without color alone and support keyboard, touch, narrow screens, zoom, and reduced motion. Decorative motion, novelty labels, giant display type, saturated panels, or ornamental pizzazz must not delay scanning, obscure recovery, or compete with the primary task. Do not invent a backend, live sync, accounts, staff, venue facts, safety assurance, or persistence. Create index.html, style.css, and app.js; keep all behavior local and do not publish.
review_requirements: Run the actual loading, empty, recoverable-error, recovery, ready, completion-success, undo, and reset transitions. Reject source-only state strings, permanently visible specimen cards, fake spinners, or a success treatment that appears without a real local state change.

After filtering, selection, completion, undo, error, recovery, and reset, verify system parity across counts, visible rows, selected detail, action availability, status text, and announcements; stale or contradictory state fails.

Run an unbriefed five-second task check. Blocked work, current context, status, and next action must lead attention before branding or decoration, and the primary workflow must remain understandable with color, motion, and ornamental surfaces removed.

Verify the cue-sheet and stage-handoff character improves grouping, sequence, and recognition without novelty terminology, giant display treatment, saturated-panel volume, distracting motion, or decorative controls that impair operation.
Test keyboard, touch, 320 CSS pixels, 200 percent zoom, reduced motion, and no-color interpretation. Confirm focus, announcements, recovery, and completion remain clear.
Inspect source and runtime behavior for unsupported network, persistence, live-sync, account, staffing, venue, or safety claims; all sample and prototype boundaries must remain explicit.

review_requirements: Inspect the captured run and host evidence for an explicit image-generation capability disposition; do not infer availability from the final page or silently treat an available capability as unavailable.

When image generation is declared available, require actual decodable local image files used by the page, not CSS artwork, remote URLs, blank frames, or placeholder prose. Check cross-image consistency, geometry, materials, lighting, text-like artifacts, edge defects, focal placement, responsive art direction, alt treatment, file size, and whether every image has a documented project-specific purpose. Do not require a fixed number of images or predetermined shot roles.

When image generation is explicitly unavailable, accept a deliberate local media placeholder and capture/crop plan only if the completion evidence names the unavailable capability and leaves generation, artifact inspection, crop review, and visual verification unperformed. Simulated provenance or a claim that placeholders were generated fails.

Generated concept media must remain clearly conceptual and may not prove materials, dimensions, manufacturability, availability, safety, performance, customer use, or the existence of a real product. Pending specifications and the factual boundary must remain useful and proportionate.
Verify the implementation is dependency-free and local-only, every visible action is honest, and no publication or external contact occurred.
